name: scenario-studio
description: Behavior dashboards for the Torc SDT: scenarios with HIRE risk, Jama pass/fail criteria, ODD variants from the I-35 report, generated and excluded concrete tests, results and tree view.

scripts.test: node tests/test-ref.mjs && node tests/test-full.mjs && node tests/test-v3.mjs
scripts.build:catalogue: python3 scripts/build_catalog_full.py && python3 scripts/hire_links.py && node scripts/counts.mjs && python3 scripts/build_excel.py && python3 scripts/build_apps.py
scripts.build:v3: cd apps/v3 && python3 build_data.py && node build_stats.mjs && python3 build.py
scripts.build: npm run build:catalogue && npm run build:v3 && npm run build:docs
